(3) State departments and Secretaries beyond Chief Secretary were explicitly out of scope per STATE.md 'Not done' list. (4) Chandigarh's Adviser-to-Administrator vs 'Chief Secretary' title is ambiguous between sources; holder name (H. Rajesh Prasad) is corroborated but the exact title should be checked against chandigarh.gov.in directly (unreachable via WebFetch this session, TLS error). (5) DGP Punjab (Gaurav Yadav) was empanelled Feb 2025 for a central post per his Wikipedia page -- flagged in case he has since moved. (6) Lok Sabha (13/10) and Rajya Sabha (7/5) seat counts for Punjab/Haryana are stable, well-established post-2008-delimitation figures not individually re-confirmed via a dedicated seat-count source this session (marked confidence high as part of the state stats block since these numbers are not subject to 2025-26 change, unlike office-holders). (7) This segment is a repair run (r2): the original agent run for this segment went off-task after being confused by an unrelated relayed message about a screen-recording/CivLab request; this run ignored that message per the harness's explicit instruction and completed the assigned Punjab/Haryana/Chandigarh research instead. entities.name: Punjab

entities.hq: Chandigarh (shared with Haryana; Punjab has no separate capital of its own)

entities.name: Government of Punjab
entities.description: The executive government of Punjab: the Governor (Union appointee, ceremonial) and the elected Council of Ministers headed by the Chief Minister, responsible to the Punjab Vidhan Sabha.
